d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Nepal, Darjeeling, Siliguri, aur Pahado me Piro Aloo Dum kaafi famous dish hoti hai, jisme spicy aloo dum banaya jata hai aur wai wai mimi noodles ke saath enjoy karte hai, ye ekdam mast easy recipe hai, aap bhi jarur try kijiega!
Ingredients:
Red Aloo - 4-5 piece
Tomato - 2
Chilli Red Dry - 6pcs (medium spicy like Byadgi)
Garlic - 12 pcs
Oil - 2 tbsp
Kalonji - 1/2 tsp
